chat.chatReset: Chat reset! How can I assist you now, Savitri?
chat.greeting: Hello Savitri! 👋 I am your Mindora Companion. How can I assist you with your games, medications, or daily schedule today?
chat.promptGameQuery: Which game should I play today for memory improvement?
chat.promptMedicationQuery: What are my upcoming medication reminders?
chat.promptProgressQuery: How is my brain score and game progress this week?
chat.promptTipQuery: Give me a daily cognitive tip for senior health
chat.respGame: 🎮 Based on your recent activity, **Memory Cards** and **Word Association** are ideal for you today! They help strengthen short-term recall. Would you like to start a game now?
chat.respMedication:
💊 **Upcoming Reminders for Today:**
• 8:00 PM - Donepezil 5mg (1 Tablet after dinner)
• 9:30 PM - Evening Hydration & Water Intake

All set! I can remind you 15 minutes before.
chat.respProgress: 📊 **Great News, Savitri!** Your cognitive accuracy is up **+12%** this week with an overall **85% memory score**. You completed 4 game sessions yesterday! Keep up the brilliant effort!
chat.respTip: 💡 **Today's Brain Tip:** Try taking a 10-minute gentle morning walk and naming 5 different colors you see outdoors. Combining physical motion with visual recognition boosts brain plasticity!
chat.respCaregiver: 📞 **Caregiver Assistance:** You can reach out to your designated caregiver Ramesh at any time. You can tap the 'Help' icon in the top bar to place a direct call!
chat.respGreeting: Hello Savitri! 😊 I'm right here with you. Feel free to ask me anything about your routine or games!
chat.respFallback: I understand you asked about "{{query}}". I'm always here to help you navigate Mindora, track your reminders, and suggest brain exercises. Is there a specific game or schedule item you'd like help with?
